title: Allahabad HC: A RERA Section 58 Appeal Needs a Substantial Question of Law
case_name: Balaji Infracare Pvt. Ltd. v. Vikas Sharma
citation: 2026 LLBiz HC (ALL) 73; RERA Appeal No. 160 of 2025
card_summary: Justice Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi held that a Section 58 RERA appeal lies only where a substantial question of law arises. The UP Real Estate Appellate Tribunal had remanded an allottee's delay-interest claim for the Lav Kush Apartment project to the Authority without deciding either side's rights. A bare remand like that, the court held, raises no such question, and it dismissed the developer's appeal.
card_tip: Before filing a Section 58 appeal against a RERA Tribunal order, check whether the order actually decided anyone's rights; a bare remand will not clear the substantial-question-of-law threshold.
